description: A router or access point, from ucode-prometheus-exporter: CPU, memory, interfaces, Wi-Fi, connections, temperatures, storage, DHCP, WireGuard and time. A panel whose collector is not installed shows no data.

panels.description: Time since the router booted: time and cpu.
panels.title: Uptime

panels.description: Whether the NTP daemon has synchronized the clock: timesync.
panels.title: Clock

panels.description: The 1-minute load average: loadavg.
panels.title: Load, 1 minute

panels.description: The share of memory available to new work: meminfo.
panels.title: Memory available

panels.description: How full the connection tracking table is: conntrack.
panels.title: Connection table

panels.description: The OpenWrt release: openwrt.
panels.title: OpenWrt

panels.description: The share of CPU time in each mode but idle, over every CPU: cpu.
panels.title: CPU

panels.description: The load averages, beside the number of CPUs: loadavg and cpu.
panels.title: Load average

panels.description: Memory used, held by caches and buffers, and available: meminfo. /tmp is memory too.
panels.title: Memory

panels.description: Traffic each network device received: netdev.
panels.title: Received

panels.description: Traffic each network device transmitted: netdev.
panels.title: Transmitted

panels.description: Packets with errors, by device and direction: netdev.
panels.title: Errors

panels.description: Packets dropped, by device and direction: netdev.
panels.title: Drops

panels.description: Whether each logical interface is up: openwrt_interfaces.
panels.title: Interfaces

panels.description: Stations associated with each Wi-Fi interface: wifi, or hostapd_stations.
panels.title: Clients

panels.description: The signal each station is heard at: wifi with its `stations` option, or hostapd_stations.
panels.title: Signal of the clients

panels.description: The share of time each radio sensed its channel busy: wifi, where the driver surveys the channel.

targets.expr: max by (radio) (rate(node_wifi_channel_busy_seconds_total{job="$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / max by (radio) (rate(node_wifi_channel_active_seconds_total{job="$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Channel busy

panels.description: Connections tracked, and the most the table holds: conntrack.
panels.title: Connection table

panels.description: Bytes of the connections each host on this side of the router has open now, both directions, the 10 largest: nat_traffic. It needs conntrack accounting (net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_acct).
panels.title: Traffic per host

panels.description: Each temperature sensor of the hardware monitor: hwmon.
panels.title: Sensors

panels.description: Each thermal zone of the kernel: thermal.
panels.title: Thermal zones

panels.description: The share of each writable filesystem's space in use: filesystem.

targets.expr: (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="$job", instance="$instance"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="$job", instance="$instance"}) and node_filesystem_readonly{job="$job", instance="$instance"} == 0

panels.title: Space used

panels.description: The share of each writable filesystem's inodes in use, where it counts them: filesystem.

targets.expr: (1 - node_filesystem_files_free{job="$job", instance="$instance"} / node_filesystem_files{job="$job", instance="$instance"}) and node_filesystem_files{job="$job", instance="$instance"} > 0 and node_filesystem_readonly{job="$job", instance="$instance"} == 0

panels.title: Inodes used

panels.description: Active leases, by interface, family and server: dhcp_leases.
panels.title: DHCP leases

panels.description: Time since each WireGuard peer's last handshake, for peers that had one: wireguard. More than 2 minutes means no traffic, or no peer.
panels.title: Since each peer's handshake

panels.description: Traffic each WireGuard peer received and was sent: wireguard.
panels.title: WireGuard traffic

panels.description: The clock's offset from the NTP daemon's reference at its last update, while it is synchronized: timesync.
panels.title: Clock offset

panels.description: Time since the NTP daemon last updated the clock (chronyd) or reported on it (busybox ntpd): timesync.
panels.title: Since the clock's last update

title: OpenWrt router
